name: roundz-backend
description: Production-grade Node.js Fastify backend base for Roundz.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @roundz/common && npm run build --workspace @roundz/config && npm run build --workspace @roundz/logger && npm run build --workspace @roundz/errors && npm run build --workspace @roundz/validation && npm run build --workspace @roundz/database && npm run build --workspace @roundz/kafka && npm run build --workspace @roundz/redis && npm run build --workspace @roundz/auth && npm run build --workspace @roundz/cloud
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @roundz/api-gateway && npm run build --workspace @roundz/auth-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/user-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/rider-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/trip-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/wallet-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/notification-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/location-service && npm run build --workspace @roundz/admin-service
scripts.test: npm run prisma:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
